author: Bamidele Akinwumi research workflow (Codex-assisted)
trigger: Outcome-blind implementation review immediately before the Stage-05D readiness transition

clarifications.reason: The frozen H2 endpoint says retained-patch detail MSE and contains no texture-subset qualifier. The full 512x512 evaluation region is therefore the literal primary population; textured_quartile remains secondary.

clarifications.resolution: Break equal raw-score values by ascending zero-based patch index.
clarifications.reason: This makes retained masks deterministic without adding information or changing any score value.

clarifications.resolution: Sort the 40 receipt source IDs lexicographically and assign five contiguous shards of eight sources.
clarifications.reason: Sharding is a compute-only partition. All five shards are required and shard membership cannot depend on outcomes.

clarifications.resolution: Use each frozen raw operational score for risk-coverage ranking and its development-fitted isotonic output only for the predeclared calibration metrics.
clarifications.reason: Calibration evaluates probability quality; it does not redefine the frozen operational ordering.

clarifications.resolution: Report expected_random as the exact full-region expected risk at every nominal coverage rather than drawing a random retained mask.
clarifications.reason: This preserves the already-audited canary definition and avoids Monte Carlo noise in the evaluation-only control.

authorization_rule: Authorization is issued only by the separate versioned Stage-05D transition after all frozen readiness assertions pass.
